findings.evidence: We use standard security measures. We have security measures in place to protect your information. The standard security measures we use will depend on the type of information collected. However, the Internet is not 100% secure. We cannot promise that your use of our sites will be completely safe. We encourage you to use caution when using the Internet. This includes not sharing your passwords. If you think that an unauthorized account has been created using your name, contact us at the address below.
findings.rationale: The policy mentions collecting information about events and products, but does not explicitly state collecting computer information.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence does not disclose the collection of computer information. Instead, it discusses general security measures and the inherent risks of using the internet. The cited DPDP text pertains to providing notices to data principals, which is unrelated to the issue of undisclosed collection

candidates.reason: Computer information is covered only by generic collection statements
